name: Boss DS-1 Distortion (DS1-A circuit)
description: Boss DS-1 Distortion, 'DS1-A' circuit (1994 onward: BA728N, later M5223AL and NJM2904L dual op-amps) as drawn on the ElectroSmash 'Boss DS-1 Distortion Analysis' schematic. 2SC2240 emitter-follower input buffer (R1 1 kΩ, C1 47 nF, R2 470 kΩ to Vref, R3 10 kΩ); C2 0.47 µF / R4 100 kΩ and C3 47 nF / R5 100 kΩ high-passes into the 2SC2240 shunt-feedback booster (R7 470 kΩ ∥ C4 250 pF, R8 10 kΩ, R9 22 Ω, about 35 dB); C5 68 nF, R10 100 kΩ to Vref, R39 47 kΩ and D8 1N4148 input clamp into a unity-gain op-amp buffer and the non-inverting distortion stage (100 kΩ linear Distortion pot: wiper on the − input through R11 100 kΩ, one end to the output with C7 100 pF across that section, the other end through R13 4.7 kΩ and C8 0.47 µF to ground; gain 1 ... 22.3). R14 2.2 kΩ, C9 0.47 µF into the 1N4148 pair to Vref with C10 10 nF to ground. Big-Muff-style passive tone (R16 6.8 kΩ / C12 0.1 µF low-pass, C11 22 nF / R15 2.2 kΩ / R17 6.8 kΩ high-pass, 20 kΩ linear Tone pot) into the 100 kΩ linear Level pot, R18 10 kΩ, C13 47 nF, 2SC2240 output follower (R19, R20 1 MΩ to Vref, R21 10 kΩ), R22 1 kΩ, C14 1 µF, R23 100 kΩ. Vref = R24/R25 10 kΩ divider with C15 47 µF. The 2SK30A JFET electronic bypass switching is omitted: in the effect-on state it is a closed path (the input and output buffers stay in circuit, as on the real pedal).

sources.title: ElectroSmash, 'Boss DS-1 Distortion Analysis' (DS1-A schematic and BOM: C1/C3 47n, C2/C8/C9 0.47u, C4 250p, C5 68n, C7 100p, C10 0.01u, C11 0.022u, C12 0.1u, C13 0.047u, C14 1u, C15 47u, C23 100u, D1 1N4004, D4/D5/D8 1N4148, Q1-Q3 2SC2240, R1/R22 1K, R2/R7 470K, R3/R8/R18/R21/R24/R25 10K, R4/R5/R10/R11/R23 100K, R9 22, R13 4.7K, R14/R15 2.2K, R16/R17 6.8K, R39 47K, R19/R20 1M, VR1/VR2 100KB, VR3 20KB; circuit-version history; Q2 collector ≈ 5.8 V). Archived copy used
ElectroSmash, DS1-A schematic image 'boss-ds1-distortion-schematic-parts.jpg' (topology of the Distortion pot, tone and level network)
New JRC NJM2904 datasheet (Ver. 2014-03-20): unity-gain bandwidth 0.6 MHz typ, slew rate 0.5 V/µs typ, open-loop gain 100 dB typ (at ±15 V)
Toshiba 2SC2240 datasheet (low-noise audio NPN, hFE 200-700 per ElectroSmash) for the stand-in model

2SC2240.note: unverified: no vendor SPICE card. BF 400 inside the 2SC2240 hFE range (200-700, GR/BL grades); IS and BR copied from the library 2SC1815 approximation

NJM2904.note: New JRC NJM2904 (2006+ DS-1): 100 dB, 0.6 MHz, 0.5 V/µs typ from the datasheet. unverified: swing_hi 1.5 V and swing_lo 0.1 V assumed from the LM358-class output stage (sinks to near the negative rail, about 1.5 V below V+). Earlier DS1-A units used the Rohm BA728N or Mitsubishi M5223AL

controls.label: Tone
controls.note: 20 kΩ linear pot mixing the R16/C12 low-pass (counter-clockwise) and the C11/R15/R17 high-pass (clockwise); mid scoop near 500 Hz at the centre

controls.label: Level
controls.note: 100 kΩ linear pot fed from the Tone wiper, foot on Vref

controls.label: Distortion
controls.note: 100 kΩ linear pot in the op-amp feedback: gain 1 + R(wiper-output)/(4.7 kΩ + R(wiper-R13)), 0 ... 26.5 dB

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: Legacy 'Bass' parameter; the DS-1 has only Tone, Level and Distortion; stored only

controls.label: Mid
controls.note: Legacy 'Mid' parameter; no circuit meaning; stored only

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: Legacy 'Treble' parameter; no circuit meaning; stored only

parts.label: 9 V
parts.note: D1 1N4004 (reverse-polarity shunt) and C23 100 µF across the supply are inert across an ideal source and omitted
